verdict.rationale: A payments platform could plausibly offer a natural-language or agentic interface for operating payments, payouts and refunds, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only AI-assisted integration aids: Agent Skills for AI coding assistants, an llms.txt file, and an integration prompt that generates code snippets. These are adjacent developer aids for building integrations, not a documented way to operate EBANX itself with natural-language commands.
